svg.aria-label: One 0.30 m uniform aperture from 1 to 20 GHz. Top: the half-power beamwidth narrows from 53 degrees at 1 GHz to 17.0 at 3 GHz and 5.08 at 10 GHz. Bottom: the gain of a uniform 0.30 m square rises 6 dB per doubling of frequency, 20.5 dBi at 3 GHz and 31.0 dBi at 10 GHz
